native_display_sweep.scope: Bounded native text-renderer fixtures for every page containing alignment, explicit positioning, large/huge type, or a Tiger Dojo start. Original/all-ages flags and three bundled English typeface settings. Engine macros can select their own font. Native frame dimensions, line wrapping, drawing and overflow page clears retained; media, scene jumps, unrelated side effects, text-window fades and user waits omitted. Not a full route playthrough, all user settings, or visual acceptance of complete scenes.
